dimensions.label: Motion adherence
evidence: let's just dive right in, I'm going to share my screen so you can see the Sensi.AI platform in action
dimensions.tip: Start with open discovery on the buyer's goals, caregiver turnover, and billable-hour economics before showing any product screens.

dimensions.label: Discovery quality
evidence: how many caregivers do you currently have on staff, just so I can make sure the numbers I'm showing you are in the right ballpark?
dimensions.tip: Ask open questions about business goals, current pain points, and decision process instead of only collecting a headcount to fit a canned ROI number.

dimensions.label: Talk / listen balance
dimensions.tip: Aim for more listening — open with questions and let the buyer talk.

dimensions.label: Buying-signal detection & handling
evidence: I'm actually in the process of selling the agency, so I'm not sure how much long-term platform investment makes sense for me right now.
dimensions.tip: When the prospect reveals a pending sale of the business, stop and qualify how that impacts timeline, decision-maker, and need rather than reframing it as a reason to buy now.

dimensions.label: Objection handling
evidence: that actually might work in your favor because a platform like this can increase the valuation of the business
dimensions.tip: Acknowledge the objection directly and explore its real implications before pivoting back to a pitch angle.

dimensions.label: Proof-point fidelity
evidence: agencies using ambient monitoring reduced their liability incidents by 47%
our model shows you'd save approximately $186,000 a year
dimensions.tip: Only cite Sensi's published proof points (e.g., 35% more billable hours, ~$500K average savings) and never invent surveys or dollar figures on the fly.

dimensions.label: Next-step specificity
evidence: Why don't I just go ahead and send over the contract and the ROI breakdown so you've got it in hand
dimensions.tip: Instead of just sending a contract, propose a specific dated follow-up call once the partner has been looped in.

flags.evidence: we ran a survey last year across like 300 home care agencies and found that agencies using ambient monitoring reduced their liability incidents by 47%
our model shows you'd save approximately $186,000 a year in reduced liability
if you sign on before the end of the month we waive the setup fee and give you the first two months at half price
Would you agree that's a pretty conservative estimate given everything I just laid out?
Does that resonate with what you're dealing with day to day?

recommendations.title: Sensi Discovery Question Guide for Agency Owners
recommendations.why: Rep skipped discovery entirely and needs a structured set of open questions on turnover, billable hours, and length of stay before pitching.

recommendations.title: Published Proof Points One-Pager
recommendations.why: Rep fabricated a 47% liability stat and a $186K ROI figure; a reference sheet of approved numbers (35% billable hours, ~$500K average savings) would prevent invented claims.

recommendations.title: Objection Handling Playbook: Exit/Sale Scenarios
recommendations.why: Prospect disclosed they are selling the agency, a major qualifying signal that was steamrolled instead of explored to understand true fit and timeline.

summary: This call skipped discovery entirely, jumping straight into a product demo and fabricating statistics (47% liability reduction, $186K ROI) not found in Sensi's published proof. The rep also missed and mishandled a major buying/risk signal (the prospect is selling the agency) by spinning it into a pitch angle rather than qualifying it, and closed with generic urgency-driven pressure instead of a firm next step.
